answer: A thatcher's reed bundle keeps Sybils out. A newcomer binds 30 bundles over 24 days, each of 500 reeds counted and bound by 2 thatchers from different crews, logged before roof test. One bundle short by more than 20 reeds voids its credit and pauses thatching 14 days; 3 short bundles void the count. A raven over the yard would spot juniper twigs in a bundle at zenith, when light is harshest. Faking 1,000 agents needs 30,000 bundles, 15 million reeds, and 60,000 thatcher checks in 24 days. Like a roof that only holds where every reed was counted, trust stands bundle by bundle.
